local __numbers = table.concat(__payload, " ")
local __source = {}
for __value in __numbers:gmatch("%d+") do
    __source[#__source + 1] = string.char(tonumber(__value))
end
local __decoded = table.concat(__source)
local __loader = loadstring or load
assert(__loader, "Este ambiente não oferece suporte a loadstring/load.")
local __chunk, __error = __loader(__decoded)
assert(__chunk, __error)
return __chunk()
